instructions: Read AGENTS.md at the repo root before starting work; it is the source of truth for Devnotes conventions.
TypeScript stays strict. No new `any` unless a Supabase join forces a narrow `unknown` cast.
Prefer Server Components; add `'use client'` only for browser state.
Schema changes go in an append-only PHASE N block at the bottom of supabase-schema.sql. Never rewrite Phase 1-4 history.
Never commit .env.local, secrets, or Supabase keys.
RLS-safe: a second logged-in user must never see another author's drafts or private bookmarks.
Use createServerSupabase() (lib/supabaseServer.ts) for server data, createClient() (lib/supabaseClient.ts) for browser mutations.
After publish/delete/comment/like, call /api/revalidate for stale paths. Optimistic UI rolls back on Supabase errors.
Zinc/black/white palette only. Avoid non-standard Tailwind classes (border-zinc-150, bg-zinc-150, border-zinc-250, text-zinc-955, h-8.5, w-6.5).
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run lint` before finishing a task.
